abilities.name: Oversight Mode
abilities.text: Set a Faction Indicator anywhere on the battlefield. While Enemy Units are Within 6″ of this Faction Indicator, they lose HIDDEN Status.

abilities.name: Pneumatized Carapace
abilities.text: Use after a Friendly Unit rolls a D6 for Charge Distance. Roll an additional D6 and use the higher result to calculate the total Charge Distance.
